I genuinely expected professionalism and transparency from Tata Motors’ authorized dealership, but unfortunately my overall experience with this showroom has been extremely poor and frustrating.

I strongly recommend customers to:

* Remove personal belongings before service/accessories work

featured_reviews.review_text:
Service Experience Review – Keshva Motors, Nahur/Mulund
Date: 17-Jan-2025
Rating:  (3/5)
Tata Safari : First Free Service 2k KMs

I had an appointment at 10:30 AM, as advised. Unfortunately, the experience started on a slow and unorganized note.

Even after reaching on time, no one attended to me until 10:58 AM. The first call from the service centre came at 10:47 AM, just to check whether I had reached, despite me already being present. The waiting area doubles as a back-office workspace, which was confusing and uncomfortable.

The customer lounge is located on the mezzanine floor and can seat around 6 people comfortably. There is a small window overlooking the workshop, but since my vehicle was never taken inside the workshop, I could not see any work being done.

The job card process started around 11:00 AM with the service advisor, Shivam. Issues reported by me included:

Middle-row seat tumble not working

Two loose screws found in the glove box (left during accessory installation)

Pending software update (last version: R16.43 – May 2025)

I opted out of interior deep cleaning as there didn’t seem to be a proper area for it, and I was concerned it might make things worse.

I overheard another customer almost being turned away due to DEF unavailability, though DEF was later arranged for them.

At 12:50 PM, I was informed that the car was ready. However:

The software update was not done initially, and I had to wait another ~25 minutes for a technician to arrive with a pen drive.

The update finally started at 1:48 PM. Although the pen drive had R17.37, they installed R17.16 instead (previous version was R16.43).

Seat tumble issue was fixed.

DEF was not topped up, even though the level was around 60%. I was told they cannot open a 15-litre DEF can for a small top-up (3–5 litres). Possibly restricted due to my Gold AMC.

Interior and exterior wash was done well, though minor stains remained.

No tea/coffee was offered, and no one checked on customer comfort during the long wait.

Overall, the experience was average. The vehicle was cleaned properly and the seat issue was resolved, but delays, lack of communication, no DEF top-up, Unclean washroom , and a generally indifferent attitude reduced the overall satisfaction. Photos are intentionally uploaded in low quality, and number plates scrambled, Hope this helps others

Final Rating: 3/5
Could be much better with improved customer handling, transparency, and attention to small but important details.

I visited Tata Motors, Wagle Estate, on Sunday evening with my family to inquire about the Tata Punch. Mr. Ramesh Sahu assisted us with the vehicle details, pricing, and a test drive. The test drive experience was good, and we informed him that we would get back after discussing the purchase as a family.

After our discussion, we decided not to proceed with the Tata Punch due to concerns regarding after-sales service based on experiences shared by friends and acquaintances.

He also stated that his time had been wasted because he had arranged a test drive and shared all the required details.

As a customer, I found this behavior unprofessional and disappointing. Evaluating multiple options before making a major purchase is completely normal, and customers should be free to choose the vehicle that best suits their requirements without being judged or criticized.

I currently own vehicles from other manufacturers and have interacted with several sales teams over the years. While not every purchase results in a sale, professionalism and courtesy should remain consistent regardless of the outcome.

Ironically, before this interaction, I was actively encouraging my family to consider the Tata Punch. However, this experience has left a negative impression on us.

I am sharing this experience because customer service plays a significant role in any buying decision. I hope Tata Motors Wagle Estate takes this feedback seriously and ensures that customers are treated respectfully, irrespective of whether they decide to purchase a vehicle or not.

⭐☆☆☆☆ (1 Star)

My experience with Regent Tata Motors, Wagle Estate, Thane has been one of the most frustrating and unprofessional customer experiences I have encountered.

I booked a Tata Punch based on delivery commitments communicated during the booking process. However, after accepting my booking amount, the dealership failed to provide timely and transparent updates regarding vehicle allocation and delivery status despite repeated follow-ups over several weeks.

What is particularly concerning is that after a prolonged delay, I was repeatedly contacted and pressured to complete payment urgently for RTO registration and delivery formalities. When I informed the dealership that my family was dealing with a genuine medical emergency and requested a short extension, I was led to believe that I would be given time to confirm my decision.

Subsequently, despite ongoing communication, I was informed that the vehicle was no longer available.

This raises serious concerns regarding:

• Transparency in the vehicle allocation process.
• Fair treatment of customers.
• Consistency of commitments made by dealership representatives.
• Professional standards expected from an authorised Tata Motors dealership.

The most disturbing aspect was the conduct of certain dealership representatives. Instead of resolving legitimate customer concerns, the communication became argumentative and unprofessional. Such behaviour is completely unacceptable from employees representing a reputed automotive brand.

As a customer, I believe I was denied clear information, subjected to contradictory communication, and deprived of a fair opportunity despite the dealership being fully aware of my circumstances.

I have preserved all WhatsApp conversations, call records, screenshots, and supporting documents and have formally escalated the matter to Tata Motors for investigation.

I strongly urge prospective customers to obtain every commitment in writing and maintain complete documentation throughout the booking process.

A customer invests significant trust and money while purchasing a vehicle. Unfortunately, my experience with Regent Tata Motors, Wagle Estate, Thane reflected a serious lack of accountability, transparency, and professionalism.

I hope Tata Motors conducts a thorough review of the dealership's customer handling practices and takes appropriate corrective action.
